title: RC1-C04 — Canonical render parity
description: Published managed site did not match approved preview — stale deploy with meta-refresh homepage and pre-canonical HTML; publish prepare rebuilt canonical instead of copying frozen artifact
expectedBehaviour: Publish engine copies Canonical Render only; preview, publish package, and live release are visually and checksum identical
actualBehaviour: Live managed site served 305-byte meta-refresh homepage; publish output stale vs canonical; preparePharmacyPublishOutput called buildCanonicalFinalRender on every publish
resolutionNotes: Publish engine enforces copy-only contract with checksum validation. Local publish package synced from canonical render. Live redeploy frozen pending PO browser test.

resolutionHistory.notes: preparePharmacyPublishOutput copies canonical only; validateCanonicalPublishChecksumParity added; rc1-c04 validation script with screenshot comparison
